notes.title: Ver. 1.1231 Update Live!
notes.notes:
Monochromiums!
The long awaited Headcount update is here! Featuring the new level "Bombs Away", this update brings new content, MASSIVE amount of bug fixes and polish. Special thanks to our dedicated playtesters and, of course, our community! If you'd like to join our playtester team, join our discord and give Mike a ping.
 
Discord.gg/monochrome

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40236448/bdf6b36840cfba4384d1409236921cc9fceef78d.gif

Additions
-Animations updated for enemy types
-New enemy types (Bomber, Truck, APC)
-New Level (Bombs away)
-New Audio added and attenuated
-Barricades added
-Steam Index controller functionality added
-Vive Cosmos controller functionality added
-Enemy vehicles gibs added
-Materials and Particles optimization
-New shootables added


Fixes
-Fixed player controller offsets
-General player pathing adjustments
-Improvement on gameplay scripting
-fixed issue where enemy would disappear
-Improved enemy spawn and triggers
-Fixed enemy soldiers not having footsteps
-Improved game pausing
-Fixed recoil on secondary grip mode
-Lighting adjusted
-2handed gripping improved
-And much more general improvements

notes.title: Minigames and two handed grip update
notes.notes:
Game version updated to 1.1

https://i.imgur.com/yOyxssf.gif

Added Minigame map with 3 gamemodes:


Skeet Shoot
Whack-a-Mole
Shootout Mode

Added Two handed grip on weapons with foregrips (rifles, submachineguns, etc). Use trigger over foregrip area with nothing in your hand to perform secondary grip.

Many small bugfixes!
